g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_front: Keys: 1000 x 600 x 800 mm envelope - the node size_mm (study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)); the build fills it exactly (hold-down frame pins the box)

Graph revision AD - ga_front: Close-coupled gas atomiser with Ar recirculation per the AQS-MFG-010 tool row (Table 2.1, rev C metering split): nameplate 5.5 kW; GMR 2.5 at 30 bar + tundish 1 kW x 1 h (A-M-177)

Graph revision AD - ga_front: Atomization tower OD 300 with powder pot, close-coupled gas ring at the tower neck, heated tundish on a stand over the tower; Ar loop DN32 to the compressor bay x 700..960
Graph revision AD - ga_front: A-MACH: hold-down frame + 8 slab anchors; purchased items named with the node ratings (compressor 30 bar class, cabinet 5.5 kW, tundish heater 1 kW)
